summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MEBO payroll system with three new features: Input/Statement toggle on Day tabs, Daily statement PDF print button, and CSV template download. All backend APIs (18/18) and frontend functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: Event navigation to existing event with employees and time entries
CSV Template download button in Employees tab - successfully downloads template with headers: Name, Dept/Emp Number, Rate 1, Rate 2, Special Rate
Input/Statement toggle buttons visible on D1 tab with correct data-testids

Statement mode displays read-only daily statement with computed columns: Employee, Dept/Emp #, Hrly Rate, S.T., O.T., D.T., Special Rate, SR Hrs, Special Tot, Total Hours, Benefit (21%), Fund (2%), Deduct (5%), Gross Salary
Only employees with hours > 0 shown in statement mode (John Doe Updated: 10 hrs, Jane Smith: 9 hrs)
Print PDF button appears in statement mode and successfully exports Day 1 statement PDF
Toggle functionality works both ways - can switch from Statement back to Input mode
Summary tab and existing export buttons (Excel/PDF) still functional
Backend API tests - all 18 endpoints passed including new features:
- GET /api/events/{id}/daily-statement/{day} - returns computed daily statement data
- GET /api/employees/template - downloads CSV template with correct headers
Payroll calculations verified correct in statement mode
All existing functionality (auth, events, employees, time entry, summary) still working
